newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel at record low on poor Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Piltel at record low on poor Q1 results.

text.p: Cellular telephone provider Pilipino Telephone Corp (Piltel) fell to a record low of 13.50 pesos by midsession due to its poor first quarter net income figures, brokers said.
Piltel, one of the most heavily traded issue on Friday, announced a slowdown in its net profit to 42.6 million pesos from the year-ago 246.6 million pesos.
Joey Roxas, president of Eagle Equities, said investors were disappointed with the results, prompting some selldown.
Piltel is a subsidiary of Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co which slipped five pesos to 1,555 pesos.
